Strategy: Complementary band preference: strongly prefer residuals between two and three item sizes, so placement leaves a remainder bigger than one item but smaller than two, while all other bins score by tightest fit; this preserves both nearly-closed bins and very roomy bins for their own best uses. It can fail when the band is rarely hit and the rule collapses to Best Fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((1000.0 - (r - item)) if (r > 2 * item and r <= 3 * item) else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
